title: Warm-up: a dot product
starter:
# a and b: 4 floats each, in slots 0 and 1. Write their dot product
# (the left fold of a[i] * b[i]) into the 1-element buffer in slot 2.
# This starter writes only a[0] * b[0].
%a  = buffer 4 dtype=f32 slot=0
%b  = buffer 4 dtype=f32 slot=1
%o  = buffer 1 dtype=f32 slot=2
%a0v = shrink %a 0 shape=[]
%b0v = shrink %b 0 shape=[]
%a0 = load %a0v
%b0 = load %b0v
%p  = mul %a0 %b0
%ov = shrink %o 0 shape=[]
%st = store %ov %p
%o1 = after %o %st

samples.label:
buffer slot 0 starts as [1.0 2.0 3.0 4.0]
buffer slot 1 starts as [5.0 6.0 7.0 8.0]
final contents of slot 2

hints: Load each whole buffer as a vector: `load %a` has shape `(4,)`.
`mul` the two vectors elementwise, then `reduce op=add`. Store the scalar through `shrink %o 0 shape=[]`.

answer.code:
%a  = buffer 4 dtype=f32 slot=0
%b  = buffer 4 dtype=f32 slot=1
%o  = buffer 1 dtype=f32 slot=2
%va = load %a
%vb = load %b
%p  = mul %va %vb
%s  = reduce %p op=add
%ov = shrink %o 0 shape=[]
%st = store %ov %s
%o1 = after %o %st
answer.explain: Elementwise multiply then reduce: rangeify turns it into one accumulator loop, seeded with a[0] * b[0] and folding in a[i] * b[i] for i = 1 to 3. No hand-written range needed.
